LanguageData.SS_LimitedAwarenessDesc: Fog of war is enabled. You can only see the areas directly observed by your colonists or character. Raids and visitors arrive silently until breached into sight.
LanguageData.SS_AreaOmniscienceDesc: Classic RimWorld visibility with complete map awareness.
LanguageData.SS_BlowSignalHornDesc: Blow the signal horn to alert the entire colony to danger.
LanguageData.SS_HostileSpottedDesc: {0} has reported spotting a hostile ({1}) over the radio.
LanguageData.SS_AccessFeedsRemoteDesc: Connect to a local surveillance router to view camera feeds remotely.
LanguageData.SS_NoSurveillanceRouter: No operational surveillance router found on the network.
LanguageData.SS_DeviceNotLinked: This device has not been linked to a router. Select this colonist and right-click a router to link it.
LanguageData.SS_LinkedRouterOffline: The linked surveillance router is offline.
LanguageData.SS_AbortMonitoringDesc: Stop monitoring the surveillance feeds through the linked router.
LanguageData.SS_HideColonistBar: Hide colonist bar in authentic mode
LanguageData.SS_HideColonistBarDesc: While limited awareness is active in authentic mode, hide the colonist bar and its toggle button in the play settings.
LanguageData.SS_LinkAlarmBuildingDesc: Link this alarm trigger to electric lights, power switches, or colony loudspeakers.
LanguageData.SS_RadarOffline: Colony radar is unpowered or missing. Minimap offline.
